summary: Facebook's automated ad filters wrongly blocked advertisements from small and struggling businesses during the pandemic, after human moderators were focused elsewhere. Some businesses lost sales before accounts were restored, and Facebook apologized.
technical_summary: Automated content-moderation models used to police ad policy produced false-positive violations on small-business ad accounts. With human moderators prioritizing election and COVID-19 misinformation, few reviews or clear appeals existed, so wrongly disabled accounts stayed blocked for days.

summary: A test by a research group found that Microsoft Outlook's spam filter sent some legitimate emails to spam because of single words such as "Nigeria" or "sex". Other providers tested did not show the same behavior.

summary: Los Angeles officials say the Waze navigation app routes drivers onto small residential streets to save time, creating congestion, unsafe turns and blocked driveways and raising public safety concerns.

Aggregated across many users, this shifts traffic into neighborhoods, blocking access and emergency vehicles and producing unsafe, sometimes unpermitted maneuvers.
